verdict.rationale: Scoping what a connected session may do is a core axis for a remote-desktop product, but the evidence pack never documents view-only, input-control, clipboard, or file-transfer permission toggles. The only related items are organizational user roles and permissions (docs-14) and customer/service module connection direction (docs-7). Both are adjacent controls, not per-connection capability scoping.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
